title: A Call For Xbox To End Cycle Of Layoffs Is Trending On Fan Portal - Kotaku
title_zh: Xbox 玩家齊聲呼籲「終止裁員循環」於官方意見平台發起連署
summary: Xbox 玩家已對不斷發生的裁員感到厭倦。他們在微軟今年初推出的 Player Voice Portal 上發起連署，要求「停止關閉工作室」。該貼文上週發布後獲得超過 3,000 個讚，持續發燒。這股不滿情緒源自過去數年來，Xbox 儘管已實現盈利，卻仍持續大規模裁員、取消專案與關閉工作室。
summary_zh: Xbox 玩家在微軟官方意見平台 Player Voice Portal 發起連署，要求停止關閉工作室與裁員，已獲超過 3,000 個讚。玩家不滿微軟儘管已盈利卻仍持續大規模裁員、取消專案。此連署反映產業對遊戲巨頭無止境裁員的普遍反彈。

title: Another Elder Scrolls game is in jeopardy as Xbox layoffs hit heads of major studio - Polygon.com
title_zh: Xbox 裁員風暴延燒：ZeniMax 高層遭裁，上古卷軸新作前景堪憂
summary:
Sign in to your Polygon.com account

Earlier this month, Xbox outlined plans to lay off over 3,200 staff throughout this fiscal year, in what it called "the most significant restructure" in the company's history. Today, as originally reported by Game File, we've learned that over 200 of those...
summary_zh: Xbox 本月初宣布本財年裁員超過 3,200 人，稱這是公司史上「最大規模重組」。如今裁員波及 The Elder Scrolls Online 開發商 ZeniMax Online Studios，超過 200 個職位被裁，多名高層主管離職。上古卷軸系列手遊與新作的前景因此蒙上陰影。

title: Disco Elysium Dev ZA/UM Announces Layoffs Affecting Up to 32 Staff - IGN Pakistan
title_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 宣布裁員，最多 32 名員工受影響
summary:
As things unwound behind the scenes, a series of spinoff studios made up of former ZA/UM developers have emerged. Dark Math Games and Longdue Games announced their projects, XXX Nightshift and Hopetown, in October 2024, with Summer Eternal revealing itself shortly after.

With years of controversy...
summary_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 在推出新作 Zero Parades 兩個月後宣布裁員最多 32 人。公司透過 X 平台發表聲明，但未說明具體原因。此前 ZA/UM 已有多次高層動盪與核心開發者離職，前員工成立的多家衍生工作室（Dark Math Games、Longdue Games 等）也已陸續發表新作。

title: Video Game Companies Can No Longer Do Layoffs Quietly - Kotaku
title_zh: 遊戲公司無法再低調裁員：開發者開始組織工會與罷工反抗
summary: Labor conditions in the video game industry have sucked since 2021. Yet its decline in the last year, exacerbated by foundation-breaking layoffs at Epic, Xbox, and PlayStation have become too big to simply carry on business as usual. This is not usual and in addition to the behind-the-scenes work...
summary_zh: 遊戲產業自 2021 年以來勞動條件持續惡化。Epic、Xbox、PlayStation 相繼大規模裁員已讓開發者忍無可忍，開始組織工會與罷工抗爭。Ubisoft 法國團隊已發出罷工警告，ZeniMax QA 工會也向微軟抗議。報導指出，開發者不再選擇默默接受裁員，而是積極反抗。

title: The Duskbloods' promised playtest is happening next month on Switch 2, and it sure looks like getting in will be hard - Eurogamer.net
title_zh: 《The Duskbloods》Switch 2 封閉測試下月登場，名額競爭激烈
summary:
League of Legends Classic players clash against old-school skin cosmetics, as the faithfulness of the new game mode is called into question
 GoldenEye-inspired FPS Agent 64: Spies Never Die finally locks a release date, and it's not far away
 Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced studio Ubisoft...
summary_zh: FromSoftware 新作《The Duskbloods》的封閉測試將於下月在 Switch 2 上展開。測試將在 8 月 21 日至 24 日進行，但從官方網站看來名額極其有限，競爭將非常激烈。這款 FromSoftware 的首款 Switch 2 獨佔作品自去年公布後持續受到高度關注。

title: Disco Elysium Dev ZA/UM Announces Layoffs Affecting Up to 32 Staff - IGN India
title_zh: 《極樂迪斯可》開發商 ZA/UM 宣布裁員最多 32 人（同主題不同來源報導）
summary: The 2020s have been rough for ZA/UM. Trouble truly began in early October 2022, when multiple key developers – including writer and designer Robert Kurvitz, writer Helen Hindpere, and art and design lead Aleksander Rostov – were said to have left the studio involuntarily. Just weeks later, it was...
summary_zh: 2020 年代對 ZA/UM 來說極為動盪。自 2022 年 10 月多名核心開發者（包括編劇 Robert Kurvitz、藝術總監 Aleksander Rostov 等）被迫離職後，公司接連面臨法律糾紛與內部動盪。如今新作才推出兩個月又宣布裁員，顯示這間曾創造經典的工作室仍未走出困境。
